name: NR7 inside-bar breakout
summary: Buy a breakout from an inside bar that is the narrowest of 7 days, over the 200-day average.

name: IBS reversion
summary: Buy a close in the bottom 15% of the day's range in an uptrend; sell a close in the top 20%.

name: VCP-lite
summary: Buy a breakout from tightening ranges on quiet volume over the 50-day average; 12% trailing stop.

spec.code:
class Strategy:
    def __init__(self):
        self.highs = []
        self.lows = []
        self.volumes = []

    def on_bar(self, ctx):
        self.highs.append(ctx.high)
        self.lows.append(ctx.low)
        self.volumes.append(ctx.volume)
        mid = ctx.sma(50)
        if mid is None or len(self.highs) < 51:
            return None
        if ctx.close < mid:
            return "exit"
        highs, lows, vols = self.highs, self.lows, self.volumes
        r20 = max(highs[-21:-1]) - min(lows[-21:-1])
        r10 = max(highs[-11:-1]) - min(lows[-11:-1])
        r5 = max(highs[-6:-1]) - min(lows[-6:-1])
        tight = r20 > r10 > r5 and r5 < 0.06 * ctx.close
        quiet = sum(vols[-6:-1]) / 5 < 0.7 * sum(vols[-51:-1]) / 50
        if tight and quiet and ctx.close > max(highs[-21:-1]):
            return "enter"
        return None

name: Pocket pivot
summary: Buy an up day whose volume beats every down day of the last 10, close to the 10-day average.

name: Weekly trend on daily bars
summary: Weekly check: buy if last week's close is 5% above a month ago; sell below its 10-week average.

name: Volatility expansion
summary: Buy a close above the upper band soon after the narrowest Bollinger width in 6 months; sell below EMA 20.
